rules.statement: Where a building which is the subject of a lease is burnt down without the fault of the landlord or tenant, the tenancy comes to an end even if it falls within the Rent Restriction Act.
rules.supporting_quote: The law is clear that where a building which is the subject of a lease is burnt down without the fault of the landlord or of the tenant, as was the case here, the contract is at an end, for the subject matter of the contract is also at an end. By the contract the tenant is entitled to the use and occupation of the building, and if there is no building to use and occupy, there is no existing contract.
